title: iQOO Z10 Lite With 90Hz Display And 6,000mAh Battery Launched: Price In India, Specs
text:
iQOO Z10 Lite With 90Hz Display And 6,000mAh Battery Launched: Price In India, Specs
iQOO Z10 Lite is one of the first phones to come with a 6,000mAh battery in the budget 5G segment in India.
iQOO Z10 Lite is the latest budget Android 5G phone in the market and now it is available in India as well. The new iQOO Z-series phone will be looking to continue its impressive showing in the mid-range and premium mid-range segment and the latest iQOO Neo 10 model is part of that lineup.
The new phone is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity chipset, comes with Funtouch OS 15 version and has a large capacity battery.
Recommended Stories
iQOO Z10 Lite Price In India
iQOO Z10 Lite price in India starts at Rs 9,999 for the 4GB + 128GB model and Rs 10,999 gets you the 6GB + 128GB model. You also have the 8GB + 256GB model offered which is priced at Rs 12,999 in the country. iQOO Z10 Lite will go on sale from June 25 in India.
iQOO Z10 Lite Specifications
The new iQOO Z10 Lite model sports a 6.74-inch HD+ display with 90Hz refresh rate, and 1000 nits of peak brightness. It is powered by MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset with up to 8GB RAM and 256GB storage. iQOO has offered a dual rear camera setup that has a 50MP primary sensor and a 2MP depth sensor. The front of the phone gets a 5MP shooter. The brand is giving you AI features like Erase, Photo Enhance and document mode.
iQOO Z10 Lite gets IP64 rating along with military-grade protection thanks to the durable design. It supports 5G, Wi-Fi and comes with USB C for charging the 6,000mAh battery that can go up to 15W speed, making it one of the first in this range to get a unit this big.
